description: A production-style pivot view of a sales pipeline in Svelte 5: a page header with title, breadcrumbs, last-refresh time and refresh and export actions, four KPI tiles with sparkline trends per region, a filter rail with region chips, measure toggles and a density toggle, and the pivot grid in a card with heat-map tinting, a pinned row-header column and distinct subtotal and grand-total styling. The toolbar expands and collapses all groups and exports to xlsx through the enterprise exportData.

faq.question: How is the row-header column pinned?
faq.answer: onApiReady calls api.setColumnPinning({ left: [rowHeaderId] }) so the region and sales-person labels stay in view while the quarter columns scroll.

faq.question: How do the KPI tiles relate to the pivot?
faq.answer: They are derived from the same fact slice the pivot reads, filtered by the region chips, so changing a chip updates the tiles and the grid together.

faq.question: What does the density toggle change?
faq.answer: The rowHeight prop switches between 28 and 36 pixels; the grid re-lays out without rebuilding the pivot.
